load_nlvr2_data_list: load the NLVR2 dataset data list from annotation file and return a list of dicts with text, label, and image paths
register_nlvr2_dataset: register the NLVR2 dataset class in the MMPretrain DATASETS registry using the decorator pattern
parse_nlvr2_annotations: parse NLVR2 JSON lines annotation file and extract sentence, label, and image identifier for each example
review_nlvr2_load_data_list: review the NLVR2 load_data_list method to understand how it constructs paired image paths and encodes True/False labels
refactor_nlvr2_label_encoding: refactor the NLVR2 dataset class to support custom label encoding instead of hardcoded True/False mapping
